about_short_description.short_description: Verihubs builds a digital infrastructure and provides a range of AI-based services for financial services enterprises.

product.name: Liveness Detection
product.description: A system that verifies the presence of a live person during biometric authentication to prevent spoofing attacks using photos, videos, or masks.

product.name: Face Recognition
product.description: An AI-based system that accurately identifies and verifies users by analyzing facial features with up to 99% accuracy.

product.name: Data Extraction (OCR)
product.description: An AI-driven Optical Character Recognition system that converts images of documents into accurate digital data with up to 98% accuracy.

product.name: ID Check
product.description: A system that verifies the authenticity of customer identity cards quickly and accurately using AI technology.

product.name: Watchlist Screening
product.description: A service that screens individuals against criminal and risk databases to detect potential risks early in customer onboarding.

product.name: SMS OTP and Announcement
product.description: A service that ensures one-time passwords (OTP) and notifications are delivered successfully via SMS with up to 95% delivery rate.
